title: Tablet Stand – Rotating & Adjustable
descriptionHtml:
The tablet propped against the coffee cup. Again.

Recipes in the kitchen, a movie in bed, video calls at the desk – and always the same balancing act with the tablet against something that tips over.

The solution: the right angle, every time

A stable aluminum stand that holds your iPad or phone exactly where you want it – rotatable 360° and infinitely adjustable in angle and height.

Features

  • The right angle every time – infinitely adjustable
  • Portrait or landscape – rotates 360°
  • Doesn't tip over – stable aluminum base with anti-slip grip
  • Fits tablets and phones of all sizes
  • For kitchen, office and bedside table

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
